title: ICU Surge Capacity Model
description: Interactive stock-and-flow simulation of ICU bed occupancy that lets students adjust admission rate, length of stay, baseline ICU beds, and surge-capacity expansions to discover the threshold at which the system breaches capacity.
creator: Introduction to Public Health
subject: public-health
systems-thinking
healthcare-capacity
covid-19
stock-and-flow
learning_objective: Analyze how admission rate, mean length of stay, and surge capacity decisions interact to determine whether an ICU breaches capacity during a respiratory pandemic, and identify the threshold at which the system tips from manageable to overwhelmed.
controls: Slider: Mean ICU Length of Stay (3-21 days)
